title: Quiz: While Loops
description: Check your understanding of While Loops.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in R?
questions.explanation: In R, # marks a comment. Block comments use # (line comments only).

questions.question: What makes a while loop safe?
options: It has a fixed iteration count
questions.explanation: A condition that never turns false loops forever.

questions.question: True or False: undefined
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: $while count < 10 { ... }
questions.explanation: While repeats until the condition fails.

questions.question: In R, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
